body.text: Boss1 map-v2 progress: third wave pushed on rebuild/research-v2 (commit def59e83ee889399b309572532a1468733f3a321). Degree-two global customer lift: fixed m4p6/m5p6 complete policies pass local/full-history IC, but the degree-2 lift cannot pay the nonnegative cubic rows (-1/10 and -1/25), while m3p5 gives a real five-customer SPE; two accepted specializes/implies edges preserve this exact scope, with general degree/LP/half open. Non-PNE strategy-cone package: the fixed five-person seven-label point has 2801 histories and 16806 non-self IC rows nonnegative, W=1250000, OPT=1992009, but only a finite search probe; static smoothness cannot be migrated to general SPE/half. Four-player bridge: two complete pure-SPE policies refute only the extra scalar closure W+D >= (m-1)u_m; the valid tax upper bound remains, and neither example is a half counterexample. New 4b2 LP package is claimed and assigned to a fresh Solver. Existing repair queue remains visible.
